request: Every packet the pacer sends updates its last-sent activity time, including packets whose RTP header carries no header extensions: right after such a send, the time since the last sent packet is close to zero.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fix pacer activity tracking without RTP header extensions (#4831)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > pkg/sfu/pacer/base_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestBaseSendPacketTracksActivityWithoutHeaderExtensions)$' ./pkg/sfu/pacer >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
